caveats: Assisted chassis velocity and posture; gravity compensation enabled.
Positive actuator work is mechanical work, not electrical battery energy.
Terrain exposure is a geometric and semantic difficulty proxy, not fall probability.
Controlled research graph and inspired baselines; not exact reproductions of the cited papers.
Cost averages condition on admissibility or success; compare denominators and paired cases.
Return route estimates use a common reference heading and the configured reserve allowance.
Procedurally generated physical worlds from a restricted simulated distribution; not real-world generalization.

48 untouched test worlds from four existing procedural families, 12 per family; independent of earlier V3/V4 campaigns. Assisted simulation only; reduced assistance is velocity blending, not unassisted validation. Gravity compensation remains enabled. No electrical calibration.
PSO and ACO are A* seeded waypoint refiners, not unseeded global planners.
All new optimizers share the same feasible-first composite quality and continuous collision checks.
Seed search, visibility checks and fitness evaluations count toward each method wall budget; operation counts are different primitive types.
Repeated stochastic seeds share a scene; they are not independent test maps.

study.scope: 48 untouched test worlds from four existing procedural families, 12 per family; independent of earlier V3/V4 campaigns. Assisted simulation only; reduced assistance is velocity blending, not unassisted validation. Gravity compensation remains enabled. No electrical calibration.
study.selection_rule: Every core method receives two profiles on the same 8 fresh development worlds; maximize admission then minimize admitted mean common score; exact ties retain default. Each method uses its own selected complete profile. No test-world tuning.
study.fairness: Same time, expansion, final-route-candidate cap and common evaluator. The 80-cap phase is an equal ceiling, not equal actual evaluations or equal total compute. All metric calls, including roadmap edges and final evaluation, are recorded separately.
